cards.title: Spoon Ferry Lunchbox Harbor
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for showing how one tiny object changes a pretend lunchbox harbor story in the cushion corner: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the paper card near a blank cover shape and ask the writer to choose one object for the spoon ferry to carry: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write what the object does first, then write the story effect that happens next in the pretend page scene: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Object cause: The spoon ferry's special cargo is ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: When that cargo tips, slides, or shines, the harbor changes by ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the object ____________________, the crumb dock crew decides to ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the ferry guide changes the crossing path by ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain it: object, ferry choice, harbor effect; write the middle link: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the final effect clearly happen because of ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the object on a paper bookmark and label its effect ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Tell the spoon ferry cause-and-effect story with one because sentence about ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Avenue Errand Office
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for connecting one invented character choice to an errand-office result under the lamp glow: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set the card in the cushion corner and choose a pretend clerk, messenger, or tray keeper together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the character's choice first, then write what changes in the paper office because of it: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Character choice cause: The acorn clerk chooses to sort ____________________ first.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: Because of that choice, the errand office ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the character chooses ____________________, another worker notices ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the paper errand changes in this way: ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain it: choice, office reaction, new errand result; add the missing reaction: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Can the effect happen only after the character chooses ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Fold a tiny paper ticket and write the choice on it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Retell the errand-office cause using because and so with ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Map Room
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for turning one invented map-room problem into a clear story chain on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place a blank cover shape beside the card and draw one pretend shelf mark, folded map square, or seed packet: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the problem first, then show how it causes the next map-room effect in the pretend page: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Problem cause: The map-room problem starts when ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: Because that problem happens, the seed shelf guide must ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the problem ____________________, the map room changes by ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the next clue appears on ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain it: problem, first effect, second effect; write the link that makes the chain make sense: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Underline the problem that causes ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch two paper map squares and mark the one that causes ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Explain the seed-library problem in one because sentence about ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for showing how one character reaction changes a pretend railway scene on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place a paper strip as the railway line beside the card and name one make-believe rain-gauge signal: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the reaction first, then explain the effect that follows in the railway story: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: Reaction cause: When the gauge card tilts, the conductor reacts by ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: That reaction makes the paper train ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the conductor reacts by ____________________, the platform crew changes ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the rain-gauge railway scene ends with ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain it: signal, reaction, effect; add the reaction that connects both sides: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the final effect clearly grow from the reaction to ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one arrow from the reaction card to ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Say the railway effect aloud using because or so with ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Observatory
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable cause-and-effect card for finding the first cause in a quiet moss-message observatory story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set the card near a paper telescope strip and remind the writer the observatory exists only in the reading nook: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Find the first cause before writing later effects, then keep the chain in order on the paper card: ____________________.
cards.causePrompt: First cause: The moss on the lens changes when ____________________.
cards.effectPrompt: Effect: That first change makes the observer notice ____________________.
cards.becausePrompt: Because the first cause is ____________________, the moss message later ____________________.
cards.soPrompt: So the observatory helper decides to ____________________.
cards.chainPrompt: Chain it: first cause, message change, final choice; write the first cause again: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: If you remove the first cause, which effect would disappear: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Put a small box around the first cause on the pretend page: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Retell the moss-message chain beginning with the first cause: ____________________.
